'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Mercenary, come here for a minute. I have an order of elimination of several groups of PMCs, the highly experienced ones. Sending my soldiers to this would be a suicide mission, so that is why I suggest you to handle this matter. What do you say? As proof of the work done, you have to bring me dogtags from both of those groups.}}

==Objectives==
* Find and hand over 10 [[BEAR]] [[Dogtag|PMC dogtags]] of level 20+ to [[Peacekeeper]]
* Find and hand over 10 [[USEC]] [[Dogtag|PMC dogtags]] of level 20+ to [[Peacekeeper]]
* Eliminate 12 PMC operatives

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +4 [[Pistols|Pistols skill]] levels
* +4 [[Revolvers|Revolvers skill]] levels
* [[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 2,750 Dollars
** 2,887 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 3,162 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Crye Precision AirFrame helmet (Tan)]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[Crye Precision AirFrame helmet (Tan)]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4
{{quote|Great, great! The clients have already rewa– uh, thanked us for the successful mission. Good job, mercenary.}}
